1  -2-  CRL.P No. 1890 of 2023  THIS CRL.P IS FILED U/S 439 OF CR.PC PRAYING TO ENLARGE THE PETITIONER ON BAIL IN THE CR.NO.9/2023 REGISTERED RAJAJINAGAR POLICE STATION, BENGALURU DISTRICT FOR THE OFFENCE P/U/S 376, 506 OF IPC AND SECTION 3(a) OF PROTECTION OF CHILDREN FROM SEXUAL OFFENCES ACT, 2012, PENDING ON THE FILE OF FAST TRACK COURT-2, BENGALURU.
 THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER
After hearing for sometime, Sri. Tejesh B. M., learned counsel for the petitioner files a memo.

The memo reads as under:
"That the counsel for petitioner is prays this Hon'ble Court to withdraw the matter and grant the liberty to file a fresh petition after the commencement of evidence in the interest of justice and equity."
In view of the memo filed, the Criminal Petition is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as prayed for.
